import rates
from bookings import Booking, load_bookings, ROWS
from monitor import BookingTracker

KEY = sorted(rates._RATES)[0]


def test_peak_after_record():
    t = BookingTracker()
    t.record(Booking(KEY, 2))
    assert t.peak() == 2 * rates._RATES[KEY]
    t.record(Booking(KEY, 9))
    assert t.peak() == 9 * rates._RATES[KEY]


def test_peak_of_stored():
    t = BookingTracker()
    best = 0
    for x in load_bookings():
        t.record(x)
        best = max(best, x.nights * rates._RATES[x.hotel])
        assert t.peak() == best


def test_no_new_lookups_when_unchanged():
    t = BookingTracker()
    for x in load_bookings():
        t.record(x)
    t.peak()
    before = rates.LOOKUPS
    t.peak()
    t.peak()
    assert rates.LOOKUPS == before


def test_nothing_recorded():
    assert BookingTracker().peak() == 0
